verdict.rationale: No data-export feature is documented. Leaving is still relatively low-friction because most Bugbot artifacts already sit in user-owned systems: findings are posted as PR comments on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps, and review rules live as `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` markdown files in the repo. Accounts can also be deleted at any time from Settings. Missing for 10: an explicit export of account data (analytics/reporting, org-wide Bugbot Automations rules, review history) in documented open formats, and independent confirmation of a clean exit path.
